The probe follows Tesla's recent commercial deployment of the two-seater Cybercab in Austin, Texas, with plans for expansion.

feed.title: Feds launch investigation into Tesla’s Cybercab deployment

This probe mirrors a previous inquiry into Amazon-owned Zoox's robotaxi, which underwent a similar regulatory process before receiving an exemption for commercial operation.

feed.title: Is Xcel Energy a Dividend Stock Retirees Can Actually Count On?
